ns2:course.label: Rhetoric Tutorial
ns2:course.description: Tutoring in writing skills to be scheduled by individual tutors. Open only to students placed in and registered for RHET 101 or RHET 102. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in RHET 101 or RHET 102.
ns2:course.courseCoRequisite: Must enroll concurrently in RHET 102, and RHET 101.
